coordinateConvention: Zero-based pixel bounds [left, top, rightExclusive, bottomExclusive]. Measured from the rendered alpha mask with alpha > 1; the items are not in equal-sized crop rectangles.

emptyBottomRight.note: The visual field is empty. Isolated alpha=1 pixels remain in the generated raster; they were preserved rather than edited.

source_metadata_scope: Original PNG provenance before Beta repository optimization, not current WebP byte hashes. See assets/optimization-manifest.json for the runtime file mapping and hashes. Original PNGs are retained outside this repository.
